taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Narrative leadership is inferred from point-in-time lead/lag across capital flow, liquidity, buyer breadth, attention diffusion, price extension, and peer reaction, with uncertainty and non-causality warnings.

Leader–laggard comparisons control for chain, liquidity, token age, launch state, regime, security, and crowding.
Rotations expire and reverse when leadership, capital flow, or narrative breadth deteriorates.
